description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_StringHash, which extends ArrayObject to track accessed array keys within the context of the HTMLPurifier library. It logs key accesses, can return all accessed keys, and reset the access history.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_StringHash
classes.description: A specialized array-like class that keeps track of which keys have been accessed, used internally within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Overrides ArrayObject's offsetGet to log the accessed key.

methods.name: getAccessed
methods.description: Returns an array of all keys that have been accessed so far.

methods.name: resetAccessed
methods.description: Resets the accessed keys tracking to an empty array.
